grid.heading: The year
grid.scrollLabel: Activity grid — a year of days, scroll sideways
grid.activeDaysHint: Not a streak. It falls off gradually, recovers on its own, and one bad week cannot reset it.
grid.neverRolledUp: No day in this range has been rolled up yet, so the grid is empty rather than quiet.

temper.measured: {percent} of that day's friction was productive.
temper.unmeasured: No friction logged, so nothing is known about how the time went.

signal.neverOnWeekday: You have never once logged a {weekday}. Your weekly plan can be built around that rather than against it.
signal.paceBelowPlan: Your last four weeks average {average, number} active days. Your weekly plans assume {planned, number}. Change one of the two.

legend.unmeasured: Nothing logged — no claim either way

backlog.heading: Backlog
backlog.nothingOpen: Nothing is open, so there is no age to report.
backlog.ages: Oldest open item: {oldest, number} days. Median: {median, number} days.

stalled.label: Stalled
stalled.explain: Started and then left, without saying so. Stopping is free — the useful move is deciding which.
stalled.row: {name} — {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} untouched
stalled.unnamed: An item no longer in your library
stalled.neverTouched: Never opened since you added it.

abandonment.label: Stopped
abandonment.rate: {rate} of what you resolved was stopped rather than finished — {abandoned, number} of {resolved, number}.
abandonment.undated: No rate: {total, plural, one {the # resource you have stopped carries} other {the # resources you have stopped carry}} no date, so none of them can be placed in a window.
abandonment.nothingResolved: Nothing was finished or stopped in the last {days, number} days, so there is no rate to report.
abandonment.noReasons: None of them said why, which is allowed.
abandonment.bounds: Because stopping carries no date, the added, resolved and change figures above are bounds rather than counts.

signal.growing: The queue is growing: {added, number} in against {resolved, number} out over {days, number} days. Finish or stop one before the next arrives.
signal.stalling: {count, number} items have sat untouched for {days, number} days or more. Pick one and decide: finish it or stop it.
signal.aging: Something has been open for {days, number} days. It is not going to happen by itself — schedule it or stop it.

friction.heading: Friction
friction.none: You have not logged any friction in the last {days, number} days. That is an absence of data, not a quiet month.
friction.unattributedSplit: {standalone, number} logged outside a session, {inSession, number} in a session that was never attached to a mission.
friction.noMissions: None of it happened inside a mission's session.
